## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-3-4597e839`

Each TankState convenience method (tan_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_n_per_l, etc.) independently calls self.water_volume_l(), which recomputes substrate_depth_cm by iterating all substrate layers each time. When multiple helpers are called in sequence (e.g., snapshot.rs:from_state calls ~12 helpers), the volume is recomputed ~12 times. Consider computing volume once and passing it, or adding a cached-volume method pattern, to avoid O(n_helpers * n_layers) overhead per tick.

### `fr-3-cbfff7db`

The nitrifier growth yield defaults were increased ~50x (AOB: 0.001→0.05, NOB: 0.001→0.04, comammox: 0.0008→0.03) and a new logistic carrying capacity was added, all in the same changeset as the concentration helpers. These are behavioral changes to the simulation that should be called out separately from the helper refactor, since they materially change cycling dynamics (biofilter reaches maturity much faster) and could mask regressions introduced by the volume-basis change.

### `fr-3-784b3602`

The nitrogen-cycle Monod kinetics (nitrogen_cycle.rs:83-93) still compute substrate limitation using total-mass values (e.g., doc_total / (doc_total + k_doc_mg)) rather than concentrations. The k_* half-saturation constants in ProcessParams are documented as 'mg total' but their physical meaning is concentration-dependent (Monod K_s is a concentration). This is explicitly deferred to tanksim-6e5.2.3 but the doc comments on the process params (e.g., 'Half-saturation for DOC (mg C total)') should note this is an interim total-mass parameterization to prevent future contributors from misinterpreting the values as concentration-based constants.

### `fr-3-460dea74`

soft_acidic.toml source water preset was changed (alkalinity doubled 0.535→1.07 meq/L, DIC 6→12, bicarbonate 32.6→65.3) without clear justification in the changeset. This changes the default chemistry for any scenario using the soft_acidic water profile. If this was needed to compensate for the volume-basis fix (concentrations were previously computed against gross volume, so totals were slightly too high), document that rationale. Otherwise it appears to be an unrelated data change bundled with the helpers work.

### `fr-3-fdb11c9d`

Use the canonical concentration helpers in the core limitation code before merging. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:76-90` still computes decomposer DO/DOC limitation from raw totals, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/algae_growth.rs:31-38` still uses raw ammonia/nitrate/phosphate totals for nutrient limitation, and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs:22-25,36-55` still uses raw DIC/N/P totals. Two tanks with identical concentrations but different water volumes will still get different biological rates, so the new helper layer is not yet the canonical source of truth.

### `fr-3-0224bf60`

Restore save compatibility instead of permanently rejecting every schema 2 file. `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:8-49` now hard-rejects all schema 2 saves, even though the saved state plus the new helpers already provide the data needed to migrate them (`crates/tank_core/src/types/geometry.rs:19-21`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs:182-186`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs:179-202`). As written, upgrading to this build turns the units refactor into a load failure for every existing save.
